atoms.b: When an animal dies, its body will break down. The soft parts of the body will ((++decompose grow)).
The skeleton is left behind and is buried by small bits of rock called ((++sediment dust)).
The sediment builds up, ((++solidifying dissolving)) around the skeleton.
The skeleton is gradually dissolved by ((++water fire)).
The minerals from the water then fill in the gaps in the sediment left by the skeleton and create a ((++fossil picture)).
